end.parentNote: Myra practised copying shapes by counting the gaps between dots and used examples such as a tyre and pillow to discuss turning shapes. They first mixed up a turned square with a different shape, but corrected this later by identifying it as the same shape in a new position; recognition of turned or moved shapes still needs checking next time. At home, turn a paper square or grid shape and ask, “Is it still the same shape and size? What changed?”
